title: Benchmark V3 / freeze 3 pre-launch checkpoint

blockers.summary: Freeze 3 is authored in a working tree, so BENCHMARK_V3_FREEZE_SHA still names the freeze-2 content commit c9b6bbe657a91808c9b91d3f46105f61b3243866.
blockers.why: A pin cannot name the commit that contains it. Recording the previous review's commit would attribute the campaign to text it did not run under, so assertV3FreezePinned refuses the launch instead.
blockers.clears: Commit the frozen bench/V3_METHODOLOGY.md, repin BENCHMARK_V3_FREEZE_SHA to that commit, and set BENCHMARK_V3_FREEZE_SHA_IS_CURRENT to true.

blockers.summary: The orchestrator that would execute this campaign has not been proven to be production baseline v0.11.0 (df215a170e6a88a6097c56f7ca404358d9d4b050); failed checks: artifact-present, artifact-head-is-baseline-commit, artifact-tree-matches-baseline-commit, artifact-working-tree-clean, artifact-package-name-matches, artifact-package-version-matches, artifact-version-matches-baseline-commit, artifact-declares-server-bin, artifact-entry-point-present, artifact-dependencies-installed.
blockers.why: A result may not claim a released baseline that the process serving its delegation calls was never shown to be. The MCP registration that would otherwise decide this lives outside the repository and can point at a global install, another checkout, or this development tree.
blockers.clears: Provision the baseline artifact: git worktree add bench/baseline/v0.11.0 v0.11.0 && npm ci --prefix bench/baseline/v0.11.0 && npm run build --prefix bench/baseline/v0.11.0

blockers.summary: The configured pricing profile benchmark-v2-chatgpt-plus-codex-credits-2026-08-24 has not been revalidated against the account and credit schedule that will execute V3.
blockers.why: The frozen methodology makes pricing a measurement dependency that must be revalidated immediately before live execution. No authoritative source was consulted here, and fabricating one is prohibited.
blockers.clears: Read the current credit rates on the executing account. If unchanged, record the validation and launch with --confirm-pricing-profile. If changed, add a new dated profile and select it before launching.

blockers.summary: 19 path(s) differ from the recorded commit, including this checkpoint itself.
blockers.why: A V3 launch refuses a dirty tree because the recorded commit would not describe the code that ran.
blockers.clears: Commit the freeze revision and this checkpoint — the methodology requires the checkpoint be retained before live execution — then confirm `git status --porcelain` is empty immediately before launching.

advisories.summary: currentCampaignCompatibility and buildResultsSnapshot use the frozen V2 pricing profile for V3; there is no CLI flag to select another.
advisories.impact: If revalidation finds rate drift, a harness change is required before launch. That is a harness change, not a methodology change, and does not disturb the digest gate.

campaign.reason: Freeze 3 changed a telemetry definition, the reproducibility record, and the production baseline pin, so under the post-freeze correction policy it is a new freeze review requiring a new campaign ID.

executionHistory.derivation: Counted from bench/results/*.v3.json records and the <stamp>.events.jsonl stream each run opens beside its shard. Campaign identity comes from each shard's own campaignId, never from a checkpoint's.
executionHistory.limitation: An event stream is attributed to a suite by the shard sharing its timestamp prefix. A run aborted before its first cell completed leaves a stream and no shard; such a stream is reported as unattributed rather than counted as V3 execution.

freezeIntegrity.distinction: holdoutFreezeSha identifies the reviewed methodology; productionBaseline identifies the released product under evaluation. They are different concepts and are never set from one another.

productionBaselineRuntime.bindingMechanism: The harness passes the verified artifact's absolute entry point as the Codex mcp_servers command for every delegation-enabled V3 arm, so the run does not depend on the operator's MCP registration and cannot fall back to a global install or to this development checkout.

pricing.operatorAction: Revalidate the rate card immediately before launch. If unchanged, reuse the profile and record --confirm-pricing-profile as the attestation. If it drifted, add a new dated profile, select it, and leave every V2 record unchanged.

solo-medium.label: Solo Medium
solo-medium.orchestratorDisabledAt: Codex mcp_servers config (enabled:false) — genuinely unreachable, not merely discouraged

repetitions.thirdRunHarnessGate: assertV3CampaignPolicy refuses --reps 3 without --resume; the review record must exist before the third run starts.

telemetrySemantics.delegationCall: A batch identity that published batch.started and did not publish batch.rejected. A refused call is counted in delegationCallsRefused, contributes no mode, no queued worker effort, and no phase boundary.
telemetrySemantics.cancelledBatch: An opened call whose outcome was cancellation; counted in delegationCallsCancelled, which is a subset of delegationCalls.

ordering.seedRationale: The seed is the campaign ID itself — freeze review plus date, nothing else. It holds no free parameter that could have been tuned, and no V3 result exists to tune against.
ordering.generator: splitmix32 seeded from sha256(seed + space + label); platform-independent

captured: Every named Sol-Luna and harness execution setting the production sources read, recorded verbatim, with a source scan proving the inventory still matches those sources.
The complete sorted name inventory of the inherited environment, so ambient state is never silently invisible, plus a digest of that inventory for run-to-run comparison.

Values for ambient names explicitly classified as safe and reproducibility-relevant; proxy and endpoint URLs as scheme/host/port with an embedded-credential flag; certificate and trust paths as basename, path digest, and file digest.

The non-secret identity of the effective Codex configuration: a digest of the canonical config.toml with secret-shaped assignments redacted, its registered MCP server names, and the authentication mode.

Git commit, branch, describe, and working-tree cleanliness; Node, platform, architecture, OS release, CPU, memory, and timezone; package, npm, Codex CLI, and Codex SDK versions; and the exact invocation.
notCaptured: Raw values of ambient variables that are not explicitly classified as safe. They are recorded as present-and-opaque, not omitted.

Any credential: API keys, tokens, passwords, cookies, authorization headers, proxy userinfo, and the contents of auth.json. Presence is recorded, value never is, so a run authenticated by a rotated or different credential is not distinguishable from this record alone.
Environment reads performed by the Codex SDK, the Codex CLI, Node, or the operating system. The production source scan covers this repository's own reads and proves nothing about theirs.
Machine and account state outside the environment: installed system certificates, network policy, DNS, clock skew, and provider-side model or account configuration.
boundary.statement: A finite allowlist of names proves only that this repository's own execution-affecting variables are recorded. It does not prove the inherited runtime environment is fully captured, and this record never claims it does. Ambient and credential state is surfaced as present-and-opaque so an unreproducible difference between two runs is visible rather than hidden.

excludedKeys.SOL_LUNA_EVENTS: Telemetry destination. The harness sets it explicitly in the orchestrator configuration of every delegation-enabled arm, so an ambient value never reaches the process under measurement, and a solo arm has no orchestrator to read it. The effective path is recorded as campaign evidence instead.
excludedKeys.SOL_LUNA_LOG: Diagnostic log destination. It decides only where already-emitted stderr text is teed, a failed append is swallowed, and it feeds no model, admission, routing, verification, or grading decision.
excludedKeys.NO_COLOR: Terminal rendering in the CLI surface. A benchmark cell drives the MCP server and the Codex SDK; no CLI renderer participates in a measured run.
excludedKeys.TERM: Terminal rendering in the CLI surface. A benchmark cell drives the MCP server and the Codex SDK; no CLI renderer participates in a measured run.
excludedKeys.TERM_PROGRAM: Terminal capability detection in the CLI surface only; no measured run renders CLI output.
excludedKeys.WT_SESSION: Terminal capability detection in the CLI surface only; no measured run renders CLI output.

productionOwned.capturePolicy: An allowlist of names, never an environment dump. A listed key's value is recorded verbatim, so no credential-shaped name may be listed; only keys actually set appear in a record.
productionOwned.driftPrevention: src/bench/harness.test.ts scans this repository's production sources and fails when a process.env read is in neither list. That scan covers this repository's own reads only; it detects nothing about variables read by the Codex SDK, the Codex CLI, Node, or the operating system.

ambient.capturePolicy: Every inherited name is recorded. A value is recorded only where the name is explicitly classified safe; proxy and endpoint URLs keep scheme, host, port, and an embedded-credential flag; certificate and trust paths keep a basename, a path digest, and a file digest. Everything else, including every credential-shaped name, is present-and-opaque.

codex.capturePolicy: The effective Codex configuration is identified by a digest of its canonical text with every secret-shaped assignment redacted first. auth.json never enters the record: only its presence and mode do.
